name: Ly Thuong Kiet
description: Vietnamese general and strategist during the Ly dynasty, famous for proactive defense and military reforms.

name: Ngo Quyen
description: Military leader who secured independence after the Bach Dang River victory and established early autonomous rule.

name: Tran Hung Dao
description: National hero known for leading Tran forces against multiple Mongol invasions in the 13th century.

name: Le Quy Don
description: Scholar and encyclopedist whose works remain essential records of Vietnamese history and culture.

name: Quang Trung
description: Revolutionary leader of the Tay Son movement and commander of the 1789 victory against Qing forces.
